biotools.summary: Barbell is a pattern-aware demultiplexer for Oxford Nanopore sequencing data designed to resolve issues with complex barcode attachments. It reduces trimming errors and barcode bleeding compared to existing demultiplexers and is available as an open-source command-line tool.
